metadata.title: DE.AE-01
metadata.description: A baseline of network operations and expected data flows for users and systems is established and managed

metadata.title: DE.AE-02
metadata.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

metadata.title: DE.AE-03
metadata.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources

metadata.title: DE.AE-04

metadata.title: DE.AE-05
metadata.description: Incident alert thresholds are established

metadata.title: DE.AE-06

metadata.title: DE.AE-07
metadata.description: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

metadata.title: DE.AE-08
metadata.description: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

metadata.title: DE.CM-06

metadata.title: DE.CM-07
metadata.description: Monitoring for unauthorized personnel, connections, devices, and software is performed

metadata.title: DE.CM-08
metadata.description: Vulnerability scans are performed

metadata.title: DE.CM-09
metadata.description: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

metadata.description: Detection processes are tested

metadata.description: Event detection information is communicated

metadata.title: DE.DP-05

metadata.title: GV.OC-01
metadata.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

metadata.title: GV.OC-02
metadata.description: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

metadata.title: GV.OC-03
metadata.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed

metadata.title: GV.OC-04
metadata.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

metadata.title: GV.OC-05
metadata.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

metadata.title: GV.OV-01
metadata.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

metadata.title: GV.OV-02
metadata.description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

metadata.title: GV.OV-03
metadata.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

metadata.title: GV.PO-01
metadata.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

metadata.title: GV.PO-02
metadata.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

metadata.title: GV.RM-01
metadata.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

metadata.title: GV.RM-02
metadata.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

metadata.title: GV.RM-03
metadata.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

metadata.title: GV.RM-04
metadata.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

metadata.title: GV.RM-05
metadata.description: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

metadata.title: GV.RM-06
metadata.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

metadata.title: GV.RM-07
metadata.description: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

metadata.title: GV.RR-01
metadata.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

metadata.title: GV.RR-02
metadata.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

metadata.title: GV.RR-03
metadata.description: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

metadata.title: GV.RR-04
metadata.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

metadata.title: GV.SC-01
metadata.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

metadata.title: GV.SC-02
metadata.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

metadata.title: GV.SC-03
metadata.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

metadata.title: GV.SC-04
metadata.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

metadata.title: GV.SC-05
metadata.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

metadata.title: GV.SC-06
metadata.description: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

metadata.title: GV.SC-07
metadata.description: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

metadata.title: GV.SC-08
metadata.description: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

metadata.title: GV.SC-09
metadata.description: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

metadata.title: GV.SC-10
metadata.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

metadata.title: ID.AM-01
metadata.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

metadata.title: ID.AM-02
metadata.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

metadata.title: ID.AM-03
metadata.description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

metadata.title: ID.AM-04
metadata.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

metadata.title: ID.AM-05
metadata.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

metadata.title: ID.AM-06
metadata.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for the entire workforce and third-party stakeholders (e.g., suppliers, customers, partners) are established

metadata.title: ID.AM-07
metadata.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

metadata.title: ID.AM-08
metadata.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

metadata.title: ID.BE-01
metadata.description: The organization’s role in the supply chain is identified and communicated

metadata.title: ID.BE-02
metadata.description: The organization’s place in critical infrastructure and its industry sector is identified and communicated

metadata.title: ID.BE-03
metadata.description: Priorities for organizational mission, objectives, and activities are established and communicated

metadata.title: ID.BE-04
metadata.description: Dependencies and critical functions for delivery of critical services are established

metadata.title: ID.BE-05
metadata.description: Resilience requirements to support delivery of critical services are established for all operating states (e.g. under duress/attack, during recovery, normal operations)

metadata.title: ID.GV-01
metadata.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established and communicated

metadata.title: ID.GV-02
metadata.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are coordinated and aligned with internal roles and external partners

metadata.title: ID.GV-03
metadata.description: Legal and regulatory requirements regarding cybersecurity, including privacy and civil liberties obligations, are understood and managed

metadata.title: ID.GV-04
metadata.description: Governance and risk management processes address cybersecurity risks

metadata.title: ID.IM-01
metadata.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations

metadata.title: ID.IM-02
metadata.description: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

metadata.title: ID.IM-03
metadata.description: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

metadata.title: ID.IM-04
metadata.description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

metadata.title: ID.RA-01
metadata.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

metadata.title: ID.RA-02
metadata.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

metadata.title: ID.RA-03
metadata.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

metadata.title: ID.RA-04
metadata.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

metadata.title: ID.RA-05
metadata.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

metadata.title: ID.RA-06
metadata.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

metadata.title: ID.RA-07
metadata.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

metadata.title: ID.RA-08
metadata.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

metadata.title: ID.RA-09
metadata.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

metadata.title: ID.RA-10
metadata.description: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

metadata.title: ID.RM-01
metadata.description: Risk management processes are established, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

metadata.title: ID.RM-02
metadata.description: Organizational risk tolerance is determined and clearly expressed

metadata.title: ID.RM-03
metadata.description: The organization’s determination of risk tolerance is informed by its role in critical infrastructure and sector specific risk analysis

metadata.title: ID.SC-01
metadata.description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, assessed, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

metadata.title: ID.SC-02
metadata.description: Suppliers and third party partners of information systems, components, and services are identified, prioritized, and assessed using a cyber supply chain risk assessment process

metadata.title: ID.SC-03
metadata.description: Contracts with suppliers and third-party partners are used to implement appropriate measures designed to meet the objectives of an organization’s cybersecurity program and Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management Plan.

metadata.title: ID.SC-04
metadata.description: Suppliers and third-party partners are routinely assessed using audits, test results, or other forms of evaluations to confirm they are meeting their contractual obligations.

metadata.title: ID.SC-05
metadata.description: Response and recovery planning and testing are conducted with suppliers and third-party providers

metadata.title: PR.AT-01
metadata.description: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

metadata.title: PR.AT-02
metadata.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

metadata.title: PR.AT-03
metadata.description: Third-party stakeholders (e.g., suppliers, customers, partners) understand their roles and responsibilities

metadata.title: PR.AT-04
metadata.description: Senior executives understand their roles and responsibilities

metadata.title: PR.AT-05
metadata.description: Physical and cybersecurity personnel understand their roles and responsibilities

metadata.title: PR.DS-01
metadata.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

metadata.title: PR.DS-02
metadata.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected

metadata.title: PR.DS-03
metadata.description: Assets are formally managed throughout removal, transfers, and disposition

metadata.title: PR.DS-04
metadata.description: Adequate capacity to ensure availability is maintained

metadata.title: PR.DS-05
metadata.description: Protections against data leaks are implemented

metadata.title: PR.DS-06
metadata.description: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify software, firmware, and information integrity

metadata.title: PR.DS-07

metadata.title: PR.DS-08
metadata.description: Integrity checking mechanisms are used to verify hardware integrity

metadata.title: PR.DS-10
metadata.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

metadata.title: PR.DS-11
metadata.description: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

metadata.title: PR.IP-02
metadata.description: A System Development Life Cycle to manage systems is implemented

metadata.title: PR.IP-03
metadata.description: Configuration change control processes are in place

metadata.title: PR.IP-04
metadata.description: Backups of information are conducted, maintained, and tested

metadata.title: PR.IP-05
metadata.description: Policy and regulations regarding the physical operating environment for organizational assets are met

metadata.title: PR.IP-06
metadata.description: Data is destroyed according to policy

metadata.title: PR.IP-07
metadata.description: Protection processes are improved

metadata.title: PR.IP-08
metadata.description: Effectiveness of protection technologies is shared

metadata.title: PR.IP-09
metadata.description: Response plans (Incident Response and Business Continuity) and recovery plans (Incident Recovery and Disaster Recovery) are in place and managed

metadata.title: PR.IP-10
metadata.description: Response and recovery plans are tested

metadata.title: PR.IP-11
metadata.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices (e.g., deprovisioning, personnel screening)

metadata.title: PR.IP-12
metadata.description: A vulnerability management plan is developed and implemented

metadata.title: PR.IR-01
metadata.description: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

metadata.title: PR.IR-02
metadata.description: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats

metadata.title: PR.IR-03
metadata.description: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

metadata.title: PR.IR-04
metadata.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

metadata.title: PR.MA-01
metadata.description: Maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed and logged, with approved and controlled tools

metadata.title: PR.MA-02
metadata.description: Remote maintenance of organizational assets is approved, logged, and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access

metadata.title: PR.PS-01
metadata.description: Configuration management practices are established and applied

metadata.title: PR.PS-02
metadata.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

metadata.title: PR.PS-03
metadata.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

metadata.title: PR.PS-04
metadata.description: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

metadata.title: PR.PS-05
metadata.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

metadata.title: PR.PS-06
metadata.description: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle

metadata.title: PR.PT-02

metadata.description: Communications and control networks are protected

metadata.title: PR.PT-05
metadata.description: Mechanisms (e.g., failsafe, load balancing, hot swap) are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

metadata.description: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

metadata.title: RC.CO-04

metadata.title: RS.AN-07

metadata.title: RS.AN-08
